   765	    (i j k : StableAffineOpen ρ) :

   767	        pullback.snd (quotientOverlapι ρ j k) (quotientOverlapι ρ j i) =
   768	      pullback.fst (quotientOverlapι ρ i j) (quotientOverlapι ρ i k) ≫

   771	  rw [pullbackOverlapIsoTriple_inv_snd]

   778	    overlapTransition' ρ i j k ≫ overlapTransition' ρ j k i ≫

    11	# Overlap charts for a finite Galois quotient
    12	
    13	This file packages the invariant-ring quotient charts attached to stable affine
    14	opens and their quotient-side overlaps.  Every overlap carries the full
    15	`IsGaloisQuotient` witness for the restricted action.  The reversed overlap
    16	comparison is then canonical by uniqueness.
    17	-/

    33	/-- Equality of stable opens induces an equivariant isomorphism between the
    34	corresponding restricted actions. -/
    35	theorem restrict_isoOfEq_isEquivariant {U V : X.Opens}
    36	    (hU : ρ.IsStableOpen U) (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) (e : U = V) :
    37	    (ρ.restrict hU).IsEquivariant (ρ.restrict hV) (X.isoOfEq e).hom := by
    38	  intro γ
    39	  rw [restrict_act_hom, restrict_act_hom]
    40	  rw [← cancel_mono V.ι]
    41	  simp
    42	
    43	end SemilinearGalAction

    45	/-- A stable affine open for a fixed semilinear Galois action. -/
    46	structure StableAffineOpen
    47	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]

    52	  stable : ρ.IsStableOpen U

    57	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}

    60	/-- The intersection of two stable opens is stable. -/
    61	theorem inf_stable (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
    62	    ρ.IsStableOpen (i.U ⊓ j.U) := by
    63	  intro γ
    64	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, i.stable γ, j.stable γ]

    66	/-- The open cover of the acted scheme indexed by all stable affine opens.
    67	The existing `HasStableAffineCover` producer supplies joint surjectivity. -/
    68	noncomputable def sourceOpenCover [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ] :
    69	    Scheme.OpenCover X where

     9	/-!
    10	# Uniqueness of finite Galois quotients
    11	
    12	The universal `T`-points clause in `IsGaloisQuotient` determines the quotient
    13	scheme uniquely over the base.  This file packages that observation as a
    14	canonical comparison morphism and isomorphism.  The transitivity theorem is the
    15	cocycle engine for gluing affine Galois quotient charts: once two restrictions
    16	are known to be quotients of the same acted scheme, their overlap isomorphism
    17	and every triple-overlap identity follow from uniqueness.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
    21	
    22	universe u
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    25	
    26	/-- The data asserted by `IsGaloisQuotient`, retained in `Type` so its universal
    27	property can define comparison morphisms. -/
    28	structure GaloisQuotientWitness
    29	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    30	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    31	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    32	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) where
    33	  e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≅ X
    34	  over : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
    35	  equivariant : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).IsEquivariant rho e.hom
    36	  universal : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    37	      (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X),
    38	      h ≫ f = pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) →
    39	      (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant rho h →
    40	      ∃! v : {v : T ⟶ Y // v ≫ g = t},
    41	        pullbackBaseChange K L g t v.1 v.2 ≫ e.hom = h
    42	
    43	/-- A quotient witness together with the quotient projection induced by its
    44	pinned base-change isomorphism. -/
    45	structure GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection
    46	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    47	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    48	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    49	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    50	    (q : X ⟶ Y) extends GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g where
    51	  projection : e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g
    52	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) = q
    53	
    54	namespace GaloisQuotientWitness
    55	
    56	/-- The comparison morphism defined from two specified quotient witnesses. -/
    57	noncomputable def comparison
    58	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    59	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    60	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
    61	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
    62	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    63	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    64	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
    65	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
    66	    {v : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂ // v ≫ g₂ = g₁} :=
    67	  (w₂.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).choose
    68	
    69	/-- Base change of a witness-level comparison identifies the two pinned
    70	base-change isomorphisms. -/
    71	theorem comparison_spec
    72	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    73	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    74	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
    75	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
    76	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    77	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    78	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
    79	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
    80	    pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ (comparison w₁ w₂).1
    81	        (comparison w₁ w₂).2 ≫ w₂.e.hom = w₁.e.hom :=
    82	  (w₂.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).choose_spec.1
    83	
    84	/-- A witness-level comparison intertwines the quotient projections determined
    85	by the two pinned base-change isomorphisms. -/
    86	theorem comparison_projection
    87	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    88	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    89	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
    90	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
    91	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    92	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    93	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
    94	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
    95	    (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
    96	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
    97	        (comparison w₁ w₂).1 =
    98	      w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
    99	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
   100	  let v := comparison w₁ w₂
   101	  let bc := pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ v.1 v.2
   102	  have hinv : w₁.e.inv ≫ bc = w₂.e.inv := by
   103	    rw [← cancel_mono w₂.e.hom]
   104	    dsimp only [bc, v]
   105	    simp only [Category.assoc, comparison_spec]
   106	    simp
   107	  calc
   108	    (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
   109	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫ v.1 =
   110	        w₁.e.inv ≫
   111	          (pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ v.1 v.2 ≫
   112	            pullback.fst g₂
   113	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) := by
   114	      rw [pullbackBaseChange_fst]
   115	      simp only [Category.assoc]
   116	    _ = (w₁.e.inv ≫ bc) ≫ pullback.fst g₂
   117	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
   118	      rfl
   119	    _ = w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
   120	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by rw [hinv]
